title: Norwegian Monkfish Casserole
description: A comforting Norwegian dish featuring charred monkfish, this casserole is a hearty and flavorful meal, free from onions and garlic, making it suitable for those with sensitivities.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and grated carrots.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, melted butter, flour, salt, and pepper.
Add the milk mixture to the potato and carrot mixture, stirring until they are well coated.
In a large skillet, char the monkfish pieces over medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes on each side.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the potato and carrot mixture.
Add a layer of the charred monkfish on top of the potato mixture.
Sprinkle a third of the shredded cheddar cheese over the monkfish layer.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
